verdict.rationale: Companies House ships a public REST API, so outbound event webhooks are a fair axis to judge. The evidence only shows pull-based GET access, a web 'Follow companies' feature and GOV.UK 'Get emails' subscriptions. Neither of those is a registrable outbound HTTP callback that a programmatic consumer can receive, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
